entries.title: Isaiah 24:1
segments: Behold, the LORD empties the land and makes it bare, and distorts its face, and scatters its inhabitants.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:2
segments: And as [it is] with the people, so it shall be with the priest; as with the servant, so with the master; as with the handmaid, so it is with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the creditor, so with the debtor.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:3
segments: The land shall be completely emptied, and utterly stripped; for the LORD has spoken this word.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:4
segments: The earth mourns [and] languishes; the world droops [and] languishes; the proud people of the earth droop.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:5
segments: And the land is defiled under its people; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, and have broken the everlasting covenant.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:6
segments: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and they who dwell in it are deserted; therefore the people of the earth are burned, and few men left.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:7
segments: The new wine mourns, the vine droops, all the merry-hearted sigh.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:8
segments: The gladness of tambourines ceases, the noise of those who rejoice ends; the joy of the harp ceases.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:9
segments: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to those who drink it.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:10
segments: The city of shame is broken down; every house is shut up so that no one may come in.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:11
segments: A crying for wine is in the streets; all joy is darkened, the gladness in the land has gone.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:12
segments: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is stricken with ruin.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:13
segments: For so it is in the midst of the land among the people, [it shall be] like the shaking of an olive tree and as gleanings when the grape harvest is completed.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:14
segments: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:15
segments: Therefore glorify the LORD in the flames, the name of the Lord Jehovah of Israel in the coasts of the sea.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:16
segments: From the ends of the earth we have heard songs, glory to the righteous. But I said, Leanness to me! Leanness to me! Woe to me! Deceivers deceive, even perfidy. Deceivers deceive!

entries.title: Isaiah 24:17
segments: Dread, and the pit, and the snare [are] on you, O dweller of the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:18
segments: And it shall be, he who flees from the sound of dread shall fall into the pit. And he who comes up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare. For the windows from on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth quake.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:19
segments: The earth is breaking, breaking! The earth is crashing, crashing! The earth is tottering, tottering!

entries.title: Isaiah 24:20
segments: Like a drunkard the earth is staggering, staggering! And it rocks to and fro like a tree-hut! And its sins heavy on it; and it shall fall and not rise again.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:21
segments: And it shall be in that day, the LORD shall punish the host of the high place on high, and on the kings of the earth on the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:22
segments: And they shall be gathered, [as] prisoners are gathered in a dungeon. And they shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days they shall be judged.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:23
segments: Then the moon shall blush, and the sun shall be ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in Mount Zion, in Jerusalem, and gloriously before His elders.
